characterization_methods: Diffuse reflectance Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (DRIFTS)
evidence: The thermal behaviour of the Co(acac) 2 and Co(acac) 3 reactants was studied with use of a Seiko TG/DTA 320 (thermogravimetry/differential thermal analysis) apparatus. The cobalt content was determined by two independent analytical techniques: atomic absorption spectroscopy (AAS, Varian SpectrAA-600) and instrumental neutron activation analysis (INAA, Triga Mk II research reactor). The total number of hydroxyl groups on silica pre-heated at different temperatures was determined by 1H MAS NMR. The presence of Co(acac) x species on the surface of the silica was studied by diffuse reflectance Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (DRIFTS). Earlier results obtained by TPR, XRD and XPS, suggest, however, that cobalt silicate is formed during the calcination of Co(acac) 3-modified silica samples.
